failure_semantics.IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: Code violates a specified interface/behavior; repair within owner scope, preserve failing test.

failure_semantics.SCIENTIFIC_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Missing or contradictory normative formula/fixture; file a BCR with affected IDs and stop affected implementation before choosing science.
